style: Use the attached character lineup as the exact reference for the characters' faces, hair, outfits, proportions and 3D art style (left to right: Karim the pharmacist, Hassan the spare-parts owner, Omar the restaurant and cafe owner, Mariam the advisor). Vertical 9:16 frame. Premium stylized 3D animated commercial still, soft vinyl-toy chibi characters, smooth matte materials, bright clean soft global illumination, gentle ambient occlusion, shallow depth of field, navy, teal and warm gold accents on white. Keep the main character in the lower two thirds of the frame with clean, uncluttered headroom at the top. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signage anywhere.

shots.K1: Karim stands behind a light-wood counter in a bright modern Egyptian pharmacy with white shelves of colorful medicine boxes. He holds a long paper receipt in one hand and a stack of invoices in the other, eyebrows raised, head tilted, puzzled. Medium shot, eye level.
shots.K2: Hassan stands in a narrow aisle of his auto spare-parts shop between tall light-grey metal shelves packed to the ceiling with kraft cardboard boxes, oil filters and tyres. He scratches his head, confused, while a few shiny cartoon gold coins float from his hand into an open dusty box. Medium-wide shot, slight low angle.
shots.K3: Omar stands behind a busy modern cafe and restaurant counter with an espresso machine steaming and plates of food, a pile of paper bills on the counter. Cartoon gold coins slide out of an open cash drawer toward the pile of bills. Omar looks worried with a hand on his forehead. Warm golden pendant lighting. Medium shot.
shots.K4A: Over-the-shoulder shot of Karim in his bright pharmacy holding a smartphone above a stack of invoices; the phone screen glows green. Several glowing green and teal chat bubbles shaped like small documents fly up out of the phone. Karim smiles, optimistic, bright light.
shots.K4B: Karim seen from behind, walking forward inside a futuristic, minimal, curved white 360-degree gallery with a glossy white floor. Frosted-glass dashboard panels float along the curved wall showing abstract teal and gold charts with no readable text: donut charts, line graphs, bar charts. Glossy teal and gold 3D cylinder bars rise from the floor around him. High-key white lighting with soft teal and gold gradients at the edges. Wide shot, camera at shoulder height.
shots.K5: Hassan sits relaxed at a small tidy desk in his spare-parts shop facing an open laptop. On the laptop screen Mariam, in her teal hijab and navy blazer with a headset, smiles and gestures at a simple abstract chart. Hassan smiles and gives a thumbs-up. Medium two-shot from beside Hassan, laptop screen clearly visible.
shots.K5B: Omar behind his now tidy cafe counter holds his phone, the screen glowing teal with an abstract clean report layout. He grins widely and gives a big thumbs-up toward the camera, delighted. Warm golden lighting. Medium close-up.
